Practical resource 01 · Commercial discipline

Quote Follow-Up Checklist

A five-point check for sales leaders and account teams to stop qualified quotes going cold without defaulting to price discounts.

  1. Named owner & next date: Every open quote above threshold has one named owner and a dated follow-up task.
  2. 14-day stale check: Flag any open opportunity that has gone 14 days without a recorded update or meeting outcome.
  3. Commercial value before price: Confirm timeline, decision criteria and stakeholder sign-off before discussing any discount.
  4. Log decision reasons: Record why each quote was won, lost or deferred so coaching targets real objections.
  5. Weekly 15-minute review: Review overdue quotes as a team every week and assign one clear next action per deal.

Practical resource 02 · Operations & Delivery

Sales-to-Delivery Handover Guide

A four-stage checklist to turn a recorded win into confirmed customer onboarding with zero missing scope or duplicate admin.

  1. 1. Record the win & scope: Capture agreed deliverables, commercial value, named delivery owner and target start date in one proposal.
  2. 2. Review & approve exact contents: Verify the exact proposal before transfer; any scope edit requires fresh sign-off before onboarding starts.
  3. 3. Confirm stable onboarding reference: Log the onboarding record with a single stable reference so retries never create duplicate records.
  4. 4. Track milestones & stage evidence: Flag overdue milestones early and define what evidence must be gathered before advancing stages.
